surah.personality_title: Al-Ma'un — The Hypocrisy of Ritualism & The Denial of Small Mercies
surah.personality_summary: Socially diagnostic, unmasking, severe, prophetic. Unmasks the fatal spiritual hypocrisy of those who perform showy prayers (Mura'oon) while repelling the vulnerable orphan, refusing to feed the impoverished, and withholding the simplest domestic kindnesses (Al-Ma'un).
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Maa'un (Almsgiving) is the 107th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 7 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِالدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ارايت الذي يكذب بالدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], have you considered the person who denies the Judgement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is he who pushes aside the orphan

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and does not urge others to feed the needy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So woe to those who pray
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So woe to those who pray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [But] who are heedless of their prayer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but are heedless of their prayer

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those who make show [of their deeds]
